content: She seems to be busy testing something. Even in such a deep area, her actions do not seem to cause much of an echo. Presumably, the surface structure incorporates some high-performance sound-absorbing material.

content: The entire area seems to be as still and silent as lingering mist.

content: Are you not afraid of the dark? Do you not get bored? We're several hundred meters underground... and those boorish soldiers are patrolling just above us.

content: You've been here a number of months, right? Haven't gone up for a walk?

speaker: Ho'olheyak
content: Nasti?

content: I'm busy, K'uk'ulkan.

raw: [name="Ho'olheyak"]I don't have much free time on my hands, either.

content: I don't have much free time on my hands, either.

content: Nasti dives back into her own work, and the screen is once again engulfed with a large amount of data, like a tide flooding across land.

content: They appear as a lattice of dead branches, spliced together irregularly. But as Nasti intermittently works at her station, they sway back and forth in a short, regular rhythm.

content: Ho'olheyak takes a step back upon hearing that one word. Her body instinctively carries out the order, as if executing a 'command.'
